cohort: Exactly the previously consumed r023 48 scenes / 192 queries; paired follow-up exploration, not an independent held-out confirmation.
inference: Baseline full three RGB arrays, then intersection with exactly one additional RGB array. No true height, scene ID, stratum or visibility labels in compatibility inference; all 3125 candidates considered. Each arm evaluated separately.
opposite_fov: Mirror original u window about fixed scene x-center=8; same angular magnitude, spacing and sample count as same_new. Every candidate query height and projected object support is in view.
aggregation: Equal queries per scene, equal scenes; width reduction = 1 - mean(W_action)/mean(W_base); zero denominator is null. Retain all zero-width and all-occluded queries.
advantage: (min of the three complete same-side arm mean widths - opposite mean width) / base mean width. Group summaries use group arm means, never per-query winner selection.
diagnostics: All four groups and overall widths, shrinkage, zero widths and full height range counts
Number of distinct old three-bit visibility patterns among each image-compatible set; identifiable iff one pattern
All candidate sets and nested intervals; repeat must equal baseline exactly
scope: Finite noiseless sampled silhouette measurement feasibility screen. Equal new ray samples, not equal satellite acquisition, monetary cost, independent views, or proof of a new algorithm. New image gain does not establish mediation by visibility.
stop_rule: No new seed, member, angle, sampling density, threshold or training to rescue these frozen comparisons. A valid negative stops only this fixed opposite-view bridge; r023 oracle positive is retained.
